findings.highlight: Even if they don’t know we’re here
findings.evidenceJa: 気付かれているとしても
findings.governingReading: Even assuming the defenders have detected them, entering through the main gate would be suicidal.
findings.explanation: The English reverses detected into undetected.

findings.highlight: go in from the front door
findings.governingReading: Shirou rejects infiltration through the castle’s main gate.
findings.explanation: The English turns the gate into an ordinary door.

findings.evidenceJa: 有無を言わせぬまま脱出したい
findings.governingReading: Kirei wants to extract Illya without allowing the opposition any say or resistance.
findings.explanation: The English omits the coercive no-objection condition.

findings.highlight: He’s going slow, but I see how stable he is
findings.evidenceJa: その姿はだからこそズッシリとした安定感があった
findings.governingReading: Precisely because Kirei climbs slowly, his figure conveys weighty, solid stability.
findings.explanation: The English changes cause to contrast and omits the sense of physical weight.

findings.highlight: near the top of a mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 山の中腹から山頂付近
findings.governingReading: Such wall climbing normally occurs from a mountain’s middle slopes through the summit area.
findings.explanation: The English omits the middle-to-summit range.

findings.highlight: Climbing is done in such extreme environments
findings.evidenceJa: 一歩進む度に肉体の機能が低下していく中で
findings.governingReading: The climb occurs while bodily function declines with every step.
findings.explanation: The English omits the progressive per-step physical deterioration.

findings.governingReading: The foothold is not even the size of a toe.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the precise extreme to generic smallness.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちは蜥蜴じゃないんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou protests that he is not a lizard capable of clinging and maneuvering on a wall.
findings.explanation: The English changes the animal and the joke’s bodily mechanism.

findings.highlight: swing my body at the window
findings.evidenceJa: 体を振り子のように前後させて
findings.governingReading: He swings his body back and forth like a pendulum.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pendulum comparison and bidirectional buildup.

findings.governingReading: Shirou judges the hazardous glass entry barely within an acceptable range.
findings.explanation: The English changes tolerability into conformity with expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 初めて出会った時と同じ、冷静な貌
findings.governingReading: Illya deliberately recreates the composed, cold face she wore when they first met.
findings.explanation: The English omits the callback and reduces composure to coldness.

findings.highlight: if you do such a thing to me
findings.governingReading: Illya says she will not forgive this even from Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concession marking his privileged closeness.

findings.evidenceJa: 真っ白になった頭は本気で腹を立てていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s blanked-out head is nevertheless genuinely angry.
findings.explanation: The English removes the unusual split between his emptied cognition and anger.

findings.governingReading: Illya’s rejecting eyes demand that Shirou leave immediately.
